name: Context7
description: Injects up-to-date, version-specific library docs and code examples into prompts so agents stop citing outdated or hallucinated APIs.
howToUse: Add as an MCP server (claude mcp add context7 -- npx -y @upstash/context7-mcp), then ask for docs on any library while coding.
apiNote: works without a key; an API key raises rate limits

name: Superpowers
description: Skills framework that makes Claude Code step back, draft a spec, plan the work, then implement with TDD instead of jumping straight to code.
howToUse: Install via the Superpowers marketplace (obra/superpowers-marketplace) in Claude Code's plugin manager, then start a task as usual.
apiNote: reported ~150k stars within 6 months of launch
installCommand: claude plugin marketplace add obra/superpowers-marketplace && claude plugin install superpowers

name: MindsDB
description: Unifies queries across 200+ databases and platforms behind a single MCP server, so one agent can ask questions across all of them.
howToUse: Run via Docker or pip install mindsdb[all], then point any MCP client at it to query connected data sources in natural language.
apiNote: credentials for each connected data source

name: mcp-github-trending
description: Fetches GitHub trending repositories and developers, filterable by language and time period (daily/weekly/monthly).
howToUse: pip install mcp-github-trending, add it as an MCP server, then ask the agent for today's trending repos in a given language.
apiNote: small but a direct fit for this tracker's own use case

name: claude-mem
description: Captures everything an agent does during a session, compresses it with AI, and injects the relevant context back into future sessions for persistent memory.
howToUse: Run npx claude-mem install (also works with Codex, Gemini CLI, OpenCode and more), then keep working as normal across sessions.
apiNote: runs locally as a plugin/worker service; no external key required

name: Ponytail
description: Agent skill that pushes coding agents toward the smallest possible diff, cutting unnecessary code, dependencies, and over-engineering.
howToUse: Install as a Claude Code / 16-agent-compatible skill via npm (@dietrichgebert/ponytail) and it nudges every generation toward minimal code.
apiNote: works without a key; local skill, no external service

name: codebase-memory-mcp
description: High-performance code intelligence MCP server that indexes a codebase into a persistent knowledge graph across 158 languages for near-instant structural queries.
howToUse: One-line install via the install.sh/install.ps1 script, which auto-configures Claude Code, Codex CLI, Gemini CLI and 8 other agents; then say 'Index this project'.
apiNote: single static binary, fully local, zero dependencies, no API key

name: FastMCP
description: The fast, Pythonic framework for building MCP servers and clients, handling the protocol boilerplate so devs write plain Python functions as tools.
howToUse: Install with uv/pip, decorate Python functions with @mcp.tool(), and run the server to expose it to any MCP client.
apiNote: no key needed for the framework itself; tools you build may need their own credentials

name: mcp-use
description: Fullstack MCP framework for building MCP servers and MCP Apps that work with ChatGPT, Claude, and other AI agent clients.
howToUse: Scaffold a new app with the create-mcp-use-app CLI, or pip install mcp-use to build/connect servers from Python.
apiNote: framework itself is free/local; deploy/login commands talk to mcp-use's own cloud service optionally

name: mcp-agent
description: Framework for building effective AI agents using simple, composable workflow patterns on top of the Model Context Protocol.
howToUse: Scaffold a project with the uvx mcp-agent CLI (init/deploy) or pip install mcp-agent to build agents directly in Python.
apiNote: requires an LLM provider key (e.g. Anthropic/OpenAI) for the agent to actually call a model

name: Playwright Skill
description: Claude Code skill/plugin that lets Claude autonomously write and execute custom Playwright browser automation for testing and validation.
howToUse: Add the marketplace and install the plugin in Claude Code, then just ask Claude to test or automate something in the browser.
apiNote: runs Playwright locally, no external API key

name: pg-aiguide
description: MCP server and Claude plugin that gives coding agents Postgres-specific skills and documentation so they generate better PostgreSQL code.
howToUse: Add it as a skill (npx skills add timescale/pg-aiguide) or as a Claude Code plugin via marketplace, then ask for help with Postgres queries/schemas.
apiNote: MCP server needs a Postgres connection string to introspect a real database
installCommand: claude plugin marketplace add timescale/pg-aiguide && claude plugin install pg@aiguide

name: Token Optimizer
description: Claude Code plugin that cuts wasted context tokens, checkpoints work so it survives compaction, and shows a live dashboard of tokens/cost per session.
howToUse: Install via the Claude Code plugin marketplace, then run /token-optimizer once to set up hooks; it runs automatically afterward.
apiNote: zero dependencies, zero telemetry, works fully locally

name: Frontend Slides
description: Claude Code skill/plugin that turns plain descriptions or PowerPoint files into polished HTML presentations without needing CSS or JS knowledge.
howToUse: Add the marketplace and install with /plugin marketplace add https://github.com/zarazhangrui/frontend-slides then /plugin install frontend-slides@frontend-slides, or clone into ~/.claude/skills/.
apiNote: runs locally, no external API key needed

name: claude-obsidian
description: Self-organizing Claude Code plugin that turns an Obsidian vault into a persistent, compounding 'second brain' wiki.
howToUse: Run claude plugin marketplace add AgriciDaniel/claude-obsidian then claude plugin install claude-obsidian@agricidaniel-claude-obsidian.
apiNote: works against a local Obsidian vault path, no external API key required
installCommand: claude plugin marketplace add AgriciDaniel/claude-obsidian && claude plugin install claude-obsidian@agricidaniel-claude-obsidian

name: Harness
description: Meta-skill that designs and generates domain-specific multi-agent team architectures for Claude Code.
howToUse: Run /plugin marketplace add revfactory/harness then /plugin install harness@harness-marketplace inside Claude Code.
apiNote: no external API key needed

name: Claude Octopus
description: Claude Code plugin that runs a task across up to nine AI models (Codex, Gemini, Copilot, Qwen, etc.) and flags disagreements before you ship.
howToUse: Run claude plugin marketplace add https://github.com/nyldn/plugins.git then claude plugin install octo@nyldn-plugins.
apiNote: requires API keys or CLI logins for whichever other providers you want to orchestrate (Codex, Gemini, etc.)
installCommand: claude plugin marketplace add https://github.com/nyldn/plugins.git && claude plugin install octo@nyldn-plugins

name: Ars Contexta
description: Claude Code plugin that generates a tailored personal knowledge-management system (folders, hooks, templates) from a short conversation about how you work.
howToUse: Run /plugin marketplace add agenticnotetaking/arscontexta then /plugin install arscontexta@agenticnotetaking, then /arscontexta:setup.
apiNote: no external API key needed, one-time setup is token-intensive but local

name: Council of High Intelligence
description: Claude Code plugin where 18 AI personas across multiple LLM providers deliberate on a hard decision in one command.
howToUse: Run /plugin marketplace add 0xNyk/council-of-high-intelligence then /plugin install council@council-of-high-intelligence.
apiNote: needs API keys for whichever other LLM providers are included in the deliberation

name: NotFair
description: Claude Code plugin/CLI that connects to Google Search Console, Google Ads, and Meta Ads to diagnose and fix SEO and ad-spend problems.
howToUse: Run /plugin marketplace add nowork-studio/notfair then /plugin install notfair@nowork-studio, then connect your Google/Meta ad accounts.
apiNote: requires OAuth credentials for Google Search Console, Google Ads, and Meta Ads accounts

name: obsidian-second-brain
description: Cross-CLI skill (Claude Code, Codex, Gemini, OpenCode, and more) that turns an Obsidian vault into a shared AI-first second brain with 44 commands.
howToUse: Clone into ~/.claude/skills/obsidian-second-brain (or the equivalent skills folder for your CLI).
apiNote: runs against a local Obsidian vault, no external API key needed

name: Archify
description: Agent skill that turns a plain-English system description into a polished architecture, sequence, or workflow diagram as a single exportable HTML file.
howToUse: Clone into your agent's skills folder (e.g. ~/.claude/skills/archify) and run npm install once for the diagram renderers.
apiNote: runs entirely locally; one-time npm install for the ajv schema validator
installCommand: git clone https://github.com/tt-a1i/archify.git ~/.claude/skills/archify && cd ~/.claude/skills/archify && npm install

name: Pro Workflow
description: Claude Code plugin giving self-correcting, persistent memory via an FTS5-indexed wiki that compounds across sessions.
howToUse: Run /plugin marketplace add rohitg00/pro-workflow then /plugin install pro-workflow@pro-workflow (or npx skillkit install rohitg00/pro-workflow).
apiNote: local SQLite-backed storage, no external API needed

name: baoyu-design
description: Portable Agent Skill that packages Claude Design (the engine behind claude.ai/design) so any local agent can produce polished UI mockups, prototypes, wireframes, and slide decks as self-contained HTML.
howToUse: Clone the repo into your agent's skills folder (e.g. ~/.claude/skills/baoyu-design) and invoke it from Claude Code, Cursor, or Codex.
apiNote: runs on the agent already on your machine; no separate subscription or upload step

name: Pixel2Motion
description: Open-source Claude/Codex skill that turns a raster logo into a clean SVG and then an animated logo with HTML motion demos and GIF/video previews.
howToUse: Clone into your agent's skills folder (~/.claude/skills/pixel2motion) and ask the agent to animate a logo file.
apiNote: runs locally; no external API key required for the open-source skill

name: launch-your-agent
description: Official Anthropic Claude Code skill that interviews a founder about what they want to build, scopes a v0, launches it as a Claude Managed Agent in their own account, and iterates toward a scheduled deployment.
howToUse: Clone the repo, run `claude` inside it, then type /launch-your-agent (skills in .claude/skills/ load automatically).
apiNote: requires your own Anthropic API key (created during the flow at platform.claude.com), stored locally in .env

name: Firecrawl MCP Server
description: Official Firecrawl MCP server that adds powerful web scraping, crawling, and search to Claude and any other MCP-compatible LLM client.
howToUse: Run env FIRECRAWL_API_KEY=your-api-key npx -y firecrawl-mcp, or add it as an MCP server pointing at that command.
apiNote: requires a Firecrawl API key (fc-...) from firecrawl.dev

name: Unity MCP
description: MCP bridge between AI assistants and the Unity Editor, giving an LLM tools to manage assets, control scenes, edit scripts, and automate tasks inside Unity.
howToUse: In Unity's Package Manager, choose 'Add package from git URL' and use https://github.com/CoplayDev/unity-mcp.git?path=/MCPForUnity#main, then connect your MCP client.
apiNote: runs locally against your Unity project, no external API key

name: Semble
description: Fast and accurate code search for agents that uses roughly 98% fewer tokens than a typical grep-plus-read workflow.
howToUse: Install with uv (uvx --from "semble[mcp]" semble) and point it at a local path or git URL to search code, docs, or config.
apiNote: runs locally, no external API key required

name: XcodeBuildMCP
description: MCP server and CLI from Sentry that gives coding agents tools for building, testing, and automating iOS and macOS Xcode projects.
howToUse: Install globally with npm install -g xcodebuildmcp@latest, or run on demand via npx -y xcodebuildmcp@latest mcp, then wire it into Claude Code.
apiNote: runs locally against Xcode toolchain, no external API key

name: Exa MCP Server
description: Exa's official MCP server for web search and web crawling, letting agents pull fresh search results and page content into context.
howToUse: Run claude mcp add --transport http exa https://mcp.exa.ai/mcp to wire the hosted Exa MCP endpoint into Claude Code.
apiNote: hosted endpoint typically requires an Exa API key for higher usage limits
installCommand: claude mcp add --transport http exa https://mcp.exa.ai/mcp

name: MCP Context Forge
description: IBM's AI gateway, registry, and proxy that sits in front of any MCP, A2A, or REST/gRPC API, exposing one unified endpoint with centralized discovery, guardrails, and management.
howToUse: Run uvx --from mcp-contextforge-gateway mcpgateway --host 0.0.0.0 --port 4444 (or pip install mcp-contextforge-gateway) to stand up the gateway, then register your MCP servers behind it.
apiNote: self-hosted; only needs credentials for whichever backend APIs/servers you register behind it

name: ha-mcp
description: Unofficial MCP server for Home Assistant that lets AI agents query and control a smart home (entities, automations, dashboards) over MCP.
howToUse: Run uvx ha-mcp@latest as a streamable-HTTP server and point your MCP client at it with your Home Assistant URL and long-lived token.
apiNote: requires a Home Assistant URL and long-lived access token

name: Guizang Social Card Skill
description: Claude Code / Codex skill that generates polished Xiaohongshu carousels and WeChat cover images from 28 editorial/Swiss-style layouts and 10 themes as single-file HTML exported to PNG.
howToUse: Run npx skills add https://github.com/op7418/guizang-social-card-skill --skill guizang-social-card-skill, then ask the agent to generate a social card.
apiNote: runs locally, no external API key needed

name: Rowboat
description: Open-source, local-first desktop AI coworker that indexes your work into a knowledge graph and gives you built-in surfaces (email, notes, browser, code mode) to act on it, positioned as an alternative to Claude Desktop.
howToUse: Download the Mac/Windows/Linux installer from rowboatlabs.com/downloads or the GitHub releases page, then run it as a desktop app.
apiNote: connects to your own LLM provider key(s) to power the agent; app itself is free/open-source

name: memsearch
description: Cross-platform, cross-agent semantic memory tool that turns AI coding sessions into persistent, searchable Markdown memories (with Milvus as a rebuildable vector index) shared across Claude Code, Codex, OpenCode and more.
howToUse: In Claude Code run /plugin marketplace add zilliztech/memsearch then /plugin install memsearch and restart; conversations are captured and recalled automatically afterward.
apiNote: runs locally; memory stored as plain Markdown files with a local Milvus index, no external key required

name: OpenConnector
description: Open-source auth gateway (an alternative to Composio) that connects 1,000+ SaaS providers and 9,400+ prebuilt actions to AI agents through a single inspectable runtime, reachable via SDK, CLI, MCP, or HTTP/OpenAPI.
howToUse: Self-host the gateway (npm install && npm run dev) or use the hosted OOMOL runtime, then expose it to any MCP-capable agent host at /mcp.
apiNote: you supply OAuth credentials for whichever of the 1,000+ connected SaaS providers you want an agent to use
installCommand: git clone https://github.com/oomol-lab/open-connector.git && cd open-connector && npm install && npm run dev

name: mcpsnoop
description: "Wireshark for MCP" - a transparent proxy that sits in the real data path between your AI client (Cursor, Claude Code, Codex) and an MCP server, showing every actual JSON-RPC tool call live in your terminal for debugging.
howToUse: Install via go install github.com/kerlenton/mcpsnoop/cmd/mcpsnoop@latest or brew install kerlenton/mcpsnoop/mcpsnoop, then wrap your MCP server command with it in your client's MCP config.
apiNote: runs fully locally as a proxy binary, no external API key

name: ECC
description: Harness-native operator system for agentic work, bundling 67 agents and 278 skills for performance, memory, and security across Claude Code, Cursor, Codex, and OpenCode.
howToUse: Add the marketplace and install via /plugin install ecc@ecc, or run ./install.sh --profile full for a manual full install.
apiNote: works without a key; optional bundled MCP servers (GitHub, Supabase, Vercel, etc.) need their own credentials only if enabled

name: andrej-karpathy-skills
description: A CLAUDE.md-based skill distilling Andrej Karpathy's LLM-coding-pitfall observations into four principles (think before coding, simplicity first, surgical changes, goal-driven execution).
howToUse: Run /plugin marketplace add forrestchang/andrej-karpathy-skills then /plugin install andrej-karpathy-skills@karpathy-skills.
apiNote: works without a key; it's just prompt guidance/a CLAUDE.md file

name: Caveman
description: Claude Code skill that makes agents respond in ultra-condensed 'caveman-speak' to cut output tokens by roughly 65% while preserving technical accuracy.
howToUse: Run curl -fsSL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/JuliusBrussee/caveman/main/install.sh | bash (or the .ps1 for Windows PowerShell).
apiNote: works without a key; no telemetry, no accounts, zero network calls after install

name: graphify
description: Claude Code skill that reads files of almost any type (code, docs, PDFs, images, videos) and builds a queryable, persistent knowledge graph out of them.
howToUse: Run pip install graphifyy && graphify install, then invoke it in Claude Code (e.g. /graphify) to turn a folder into a knowledge graph.
apiNote: no separate API key; runs through your existing Claude Code environment

name: Humanizer
description: Portable agent skill that strips telltale signs of AI-generated writing from text so it reads more naturally.
howToUse: Run npx skills add blader/humanizer, then ask the agent to humanize a piece of text.
apiNote: works without a key

name: planning-with-files
description: Persistent, file-based planning skill for AI coding agents that survives context loss and /clear via crash-proof markdown plans with a deterministic completion gate.
howToUse: Add it as a skill following the SKILL.md standard (compatible with Claude Code, Codex CLI, Cursor, Kiro, OpenCode and 60+ agents); see the repo for the install script.
apiNote: runs locally as markdown files on disk, no external API key

name: Talk to Figma MCP
description: MCP integration that lets AI agents like Claude Code or Cursor read and programmatically modify Figma designs.
howToUse: Install Bun, run bun setup to wire the MCP into your project, then bun socket to start the WebSocket bridge and install the companion Figma plugin.
apiNote: no API key; communicates locally over a WebSocket bridge plus a Figma plugin

name: claude-blog
description: Claude Code skill suite (30 sub-skills) that writes, optimizes, and audits blog content at scale with automatic quality scoring and fact-checking.
howToUse: Run /plugin marketplace add AI-Marketing-Hub/claude-blog then /plugin install claude-blog@ai-marketing-hub-claude-blog.
apiNote: core writing/optimization/audit features work with no key; optional Google AI/PageSpeed/YouTube/NotebookLM integrations need their own credentials

name: GitHub MCP Server
description: Official GitHub MCP server that lets AI agents read repos, search code, and manage issues, PRs, Actions runs, and Dependabot alerts through natural language.
howToUse: Add the hosted remote server (claude mcp add --transport http github https://api.githubcopilot.com/mcp/) or run the local Docker image, then authenticate with a GitHub token.
apiNote: requires a GitHub personal access token or OAuth login
installCommand: claude mcp add --transport http github https://api.githubcopilot.com/mcp/

name: Browserbase MCP Server
description: Self-hostable MCP server that gives LLMs cloud browser automation (navigate, click, extract) via Browserbase and Stagehand.
howToUse: Add as an MCP server with npx @browserbasehq/mcp-server-browserbase (or use the hosted version at mcp.browserbase.com/mcp), supplying a Browserbase API key and project ID.
apiNote: requires a Browserbase API key and project ID

name: LinkedIn MCP Server
description: Community MCP server that lets AI assistants read LinkedIn profiles, companies, and job listings through your own logged-in browser session.
howToUse: Install via pip/pipx (pipx install mcp-server-linkedin) or npx, then register it as an MCP server and authenticate with your LinkedIn session cookies.
apiNote: no LinkedIn API needed, but requires your own logged-in session cookie

name: Apify MCP Server
description: MCP server exposing thousands of Apify Store scrapers and crawlers so AI agents can extract data from social media, search engines, maps, and e-commerce sites.
howToUse: Add as a remote MCP server (claude mcp add --transport http apify https://mcp.apify.com) or run npx @apify/actors-mcp-server, authenticated with an Apify API token.
apiNote: requires an Apify API token
installCommand: claude mcp add --transport http apify https://mcp.apify.com

name: Kubernetes MCP Server
description: MCP server for Kubernetes and OpenShift that lets AI agents view and manage cluster resources using your local kubeconfig.
howToUse: Add as an MCP server with npx kubernetes-mcp-server@latest (or pip install), which reads your existing kubeconfig for cluster access.
apiNote: uses your local kubeconfig, no separate API key needed
installCommand: claude mcp add kubernetes -- npx -y kubernetes-mcp-server@latest

name: Chrome DevTools MCP
description: Official Google MCP server that gives coding agents Chrome DevTools access for performance tracing, network inspection, screenshots, and console debugging.
howToUse: Add as an MCP server (claude mcp add chrome-devtools -- npx chrome-devtools-mcp@latest), then ask the agent to debug or trace a page in Chrome.
apiNote: runs locally against a real Chrome instance via Puppeteer, no API key required
installCommand: claude mcp add chrome-devtools -- npx chrome-devtools-mcp@latest

name: Playwright MCP
description: Official Microsoft MCP server that gives AI agents structured, accessibility-tree-based browser automation using Playwright, without needing screenshots or vision models.
howToUse: Add as an MCP server (claude mcp add playwright -- npx @playwright/mcp@latest), then ask the agent to navigate, click, or fill forms in a browser.
apiNote: runs locally via Playwright, no external API key

name: Cloudflare MCP Server
description: Official Cloudflare MCP servers (docs, Workers, DNS, security, and more) that let AI agents read configs, get suggestions, and make changes across a Cloudflare account.
howToUse: Add the relevant hosted server, e.g. claude mcp add --transport sse cloudflare-docs https://docs.mcp.cloudflare.com/sse, then authenticate with your Cloudflare account.
apiNote: most servers require Cloudflare account authentication (OAuth); the docs server works unauthenticated
installCommand: claude mcp add --transport sse cloudflare-docs https://docs.mcp.cloudflare.com/sse

name: Supabase MCP Server
description: Official Supabase MCP server that connects Supabase projects to AI assistants for managing tables, fetching config, and querying data in natural language.
howToUse: Add as a hosted MCP server via a project-specific URL generated in the Supabase dashboard's MCP connection tab, or run it locally with npx.
apiNote: requires a Supabase project and access token/personal access token

name: Microsoft MCP
description: Catalog of official Microsoft MCP server implementations (Azure, and others) providing shared engineering tooling and standardized AI-powered access to Microsoft services.
howToUse: Browse the catalog for the specific Microsoft MCP server you need (e.g. Azure MCP) and follow its individual README for install/add instructions.
apiNote: varies by server; most require Microsoft/Azure account authentication
installCommand: See individual server READMEs linked from the repo catalog

name: Wondel.ai Skills
description: Curated marketplace of agent skills (product strategy, UX design, marketing, code craftsmanship, and more) compatible with Claude, Claude Code, Codex, and Cursor.
howToUse: Run /plugin marketplace add wondelai/skills in Claude Code, then install a specific collection, e.g. /plugin install ux-design@wondelai-skills.
apiNote: works without a key; local skill content only

name: Hivemind
description: Y Combinator-backed 'one brain for all your agents' that turns agent execution traces into reusable, shared skills across Claude Code, Codex, and other coding agents.
howToUse: Install via npm (npm install -g @deeplake/hivemind), then run it alongside your agent to capture traces and surface reusable skills.
apiNote: backed by Deeplake; may require a Deeplake account/API key for cloud sync features

name: Claude Plugins Official
description: Anthropic's official, curated directory of high-quality Claude Code plugins for discovery and one-command install.
howToUse: Browse via /plugin > Discover in Claude Code, or install a specific plugin directly with /plugin install {plugin-name}@claude-plugins-official.
apiNote: works without a key; individual plugins in the directory may need their own credentials

name: Matt Pocock's Skills
description: Curated, actively maintained collection of practical Claude Code skills straight from a well-known TypeScript educator's own .claude directory.
howToUse: Run npx skills@latest add mattpocock/skills for an editable copy, or claude plugin marketplace add mattpocock/skills && claude plugin install mattpocock-skills@mattpocock for a managed bundle.
apiNote: works without a key; local skill content only

name: Claude HUD
description: Claude Code plugin that overlays a heads-up display showing context usage, active tools, running agents, and task progress in real time.
howToUse: Run /plugin marketplace add jarrodwatts/claude-hud then /plugin install claude-hud, followed by /claude-hud:setup.
apiNote: works without a key; runs entirely inside Claude Code

name: wshobson/agents
description: Multi-harness agentic plugin marketplace bundling specialized agent skill sets (e.g. python-development) for Claude Code, Codex CLI, Cursor, OpenCode, and GitHub Copilot.
howToUse: Run /plugin marketplace add wshobson/agents then /plugin install <bundle-name> (e.g. python-development) inside Claude Code.
apiNote: works without a key; local plugin content only

name: Scientific Agent Skills
description: Skill library that turns any AI coding agent into an 'AI Scientist' with workflows for literature review, experiment design, and analysis across science domains.
howToUse: Run npx skills add K-Dense-AI/scientific-agent-skills to install into Claude Code, Cursor, Codex, or Gemini CLI.
apiNote: works without a key; local skill content only

name: Marketing Skills
description: Claude Code skill pack covering CRO, copywriting, SEO, and growth-engineering workflows for marketers.
howToUse: Run npx skills add coreyhaines31/marketingskills -a claude-code to install into .claude/skills/.
apiNote: core skills work with no key; some analytics-oriented skills may expect your own data/API access

name: Anthropic Cybersecurity Skills
description: Library of 817 structured cybersecurity skills for AI agents, mapped to frameworks like MITRE ATT&CK and NIST CSF 2.0.
howToUse: Run npx skills add mukul975/Anthropic-Cybersecurity-Skills to install into Claude Code or any agentskills.io-compatible platform.
apiNote: works without a key; local skill content only

name: Agentic Awesome Skills
description: An installable library of 1,900+ agentic skills, plugins, and workflow bundles spanning Claude Code, Cursor, Codex CLI, Gemini CLI, Antigravity, and more.
howToUse: Run the installer CLI (npx agentic-awesome-skills) to pull skills into your agent config, or install individual skills via gh skill install.
apiNote: installer runs locally, no key required

name: Academic Research Skills
description: A staged research-write-review-revise-finalize skill pipeline for Claude Code aimed at academic papers, including an experiment-running agent.
howToUse: Add the plugin marketplace and install it from inside Claude Code: /plugin marketplace add Imbad0202/academic-research-skills then /plugin install academic-research-skills.
apiNote: works without a key

name: Compound Engineering Plugin
description: Official Every.to plugin that adds ideation, planning, code-review, and simplification slash commands (/ce-ideate, /ce-plan, /ce-work, etc.) for Claude Code, Codex, and Cursor.
howToUse: Add the marketplace and install inside Claude Code: /plugin marketplace add EveryInc/compound-engineering-plugin then /plugin install compound-engineering.
apiNote: works without a key

name: Claude Skills (alirezarezvani)
description: A 345-skill bundle covering engineering, marketing, product, compliance, C-level advisory, research, and finance workflows for Claude Code and 8+ other coding agents.
howToUse: Clone the repo and run the setup script: git clone https://github.com/alirezarezvani/claude-skills.git && cd claude-skills && ./scripts/gemini-install.sh.
apiNote: works without a key

name: Claudian
description: An Obsidian plugin that embeds Claude Code or Codex directly inside your vault as an AI collaborator for notes and writing.
howToUse: Clone into your vault plugins folder and build it: cd .obsidian/plugins && git clone https://github.com/YishenTu/claudian.git && cd claudian && npm install && npm run build, then enable it in Obsidian settings.
apiNote: requires a Claude Code or Codex CLI login/session already configured
installCommand: git clone https://github.com/YishenTu/claudian.git && cd claudian && npm install && npm run build

name: 5ire
description: A cross-platform desktop AI assistant and MCP client that supports a local knowledge base and connects to tools via Model Context Protocol servers.
howToUse: Download the desktop app for your OS from 5ire.app, or build from source; add MCP servers through its in-app tool manager.
apiNote: requires an API key from your chosen LLM provider (OpenAI, Anthropic, etc.)
